title: cloud-connection: install-local's cloud branch still accepts a package whose security-catalog name or namespace another package holds, then refuses it at every restart
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5o8PE7ZtVjcor51wBZ

Filing gate: ② routed from the contract review of PR #31388 (#31296; record 6717860915, out-of-scope findings, the dev's measurement confirmed in code). ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: the seat that owns `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` (the cloud branch of `POST /marketplace/install-local`, `refusesEnvironmentHeldCatalogName`).
Dedupe (open AND closed): `install-local security catalog lenient`, `refusesEnvironmentHeldCatalogName package holder`, `NamespaceConflictError install-local cloud` → only #31296 (the bare-name half, PR #31388).
reach: every cloud-branch install-local of a package whose permission set / position / other security-catalog name another package or a built-in already holds, and (read, not measured) a package whose namespace another package holds.
class: a · type: Bug
Grade: p2 — self-graded by the server seat (Ruling-ref: the maintainer, 「定级你可以自己决定」): the sibling of #31296 on the same door.

## 维护者速读

本地安装的云端分支在注册失败时，只把「环境已持有的目录名」当作真拒绝。安全目录（权限集、岗位等）的同名冲突，如果持有者是另一个包或内置，以及命名空间冲突（`NamespaceConflictError`），仍走「下次重启再加载」的宽松路径：写入安装记录、回答 200(`hotLoaded: false`)，此后每次启动恢复时都被同一条规则再次拒绝，永远加载不了，门口却说成功。应当和内联分支、以及 #31296 修好的同名规则一样，直接 422 拒绝，什么都不写。

## What is wrong

- **Measured by the #31296 dev:** a cloud-branch install of a package declaring a security-catalog name a package already holds answers `200`, `hotLoaded: false`, and the ledger entry is written. `refusesEnvironmentHeldCatalogName` still recognises only `existingHolder.kind === 'environment'`; `refuseSecurityCatalogNameConflicts` has no seal, so the ledgered entry is refused again at every rehydrate and never loads.
- **Read, not measured:** `NamespaceConflictError` (the same wire code as the bare-name refusal, a different error name) takes the same lenient path and is refused again at every rehydrate.

## Expected

- The cloud branch refuses both the way the inline branch does: 422, holders named, nothing written to the ledger. Reuse the recognisers the inline branch and #31296's predicate already use (code + name), ⛔ no copy of any holder rule.
- Pins: a held security-catalog name (package holder; built-in holder) → 422, ledger unchanged; a held namespace → 422 (measure first); CONTROLs: an environment-held catalog name keeps its current answer; a fresh name installs.

Related: #31296 / PR #31388, #22695, #25366.
